recipe.name: x14
recipe.change_vs_x9: patches 0921 (tokenize without holding the GIL, port of MiaAI-Lab 0099) + 0923 (fastokens 0.3.2 prompt encoding, TF_W1_FASTOKENS=1); IMAGE_EXTRAS + fastokens==0.3.2; every other knob identical

hardware: 4x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q (96 GB each, PCIe, TP4), 250 W cap
measured_at: 2026-10-13, x14 and x9 in the same window
method: unique prompts per request (no prefix-cache hits), temperature 0

long_session_corun.setup: a 400k-token cached session sends a request every 1 s (85 tokens out) while one short request decodes
long_session_corun.why: in x9 each 400k-token request is tokenized by HF tokenizers (707-855 ms for 400k tokens) with the GIL held, which stalls the engine loop and the short stream once a second; x14 tokenizes it with fastokens in 41-44 ms with the GIL released

correctness_x14.token_identity: 0 mismatches over 5,857,088 tokens (results/tok-check-x14-2026-10-13.log), mutation proof red on A and B
